description:
Make a hosted sales page for one account, with the same page as a one-page PDF, in a catalog design system. Pass the account's company, website, offer and call-to-action link. Better Design writes the headline and the copy you leave out, and draws the page's visual. When an ad sends visitors to the page, pass it as `ad`: the page then repeats the ad's headline, words, offer and call to action.

Each call spends 3 Better Design credits and returns public links at once: `viewUrl` shows progress, then the page, for anyone who has it; `imageUrl` is a PNG of the page and `pdfUrl` the PDF, both working once the page is ready. Take `designSystemId` from find-design-system. It needs a Better Design account with a verified email.

ad.description: Optional. The ad that sends visitors to this page. Pass it so the page repeats the ad's headline, words, offer and call to action.

callToAction.description: The ad's call to action. It becomes the button label unless you pass ctaLabel.

description.description: The ad's description text. The page reuses its keywords and phrases.

headline.description: The ad's headline. It becomes the page headline unless you pass headline.

offer.description: The ad's offer, such as "Free 14-day trial". The page states it in the same terms.

ctaLabel.description: Optional. The button label, for example "Book a call".

ctaUrl.description: Where the call to action goes, for example your calendar link.

designSystemId.description: A catalog design system id from find-design-system, for example "cashmere". It sets the colours and type.

headline.description: Optional. The page's headline. Left out, Better Design writes it.

notes.description: Optional. What you know about the account: its business, its problem, the conversation so far.

offer.description: What you offer this account and what it gets.

problem.description: Optional. The problem the account has today. Left out, Better Design writes it.

proof1.description: Optional. A proof point, such as a result or a customer quote.

website.description: The account's website, for example https://acme.com.

name: make-sales-page
title: Make a Sales Page
